+import pytest
+
+from dotenv.variables import parse_variables
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "env,expression,expected",
+    [
+        ({}, "${X:+word}", ""),
+        ({"X": None}, "${X:+word}", ""),
+        ({"X": ""}, "${X:+word}", ""),
+        ({"X": "value"}, "${X:+word}", "word"),
+        ({"X": "0"}, "${X:+word}", "word"),
+        ({"X": "value"}, "${X:+}", ""),
+        ({"X": "value"}, "a${X:+$Y / tail}b", "a$Y / tailb"),
+        ({}, "${X:-fallback}", "fallback"),
+        ({"X": None}, "${X:-fallback}", ""),
+        ({"X": ""}, "${X:-fallback}", ""),
+        ({"X": "value"}, "$X", "$X"),
+        ({"X": "value"}, "${X:word}", "${X:word}"),
+        ({"X-Y": "value"}, "${X-Y:+yes}", "yes"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_alternative_expansion(env, expression, expected):
+    assert "".join(atom.resolve(env) for atom in parse_variables(expression)) == expected
+
+
+def test_expansion_atom_identity():
+    present = list(parse_variables("${X:+word}"))[0]
+    other = list(parse_variables("${X:+other}"))[0]
+    default = list(parse_variables("${X:-word}"))[0]
+    same = list(parse_variables("${X:+word}"))[0]
+    assert present == same
+    assert hash(present) == hash(same)
+    assert len({present, other, default}) == 3
